
[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:16[/yellow bold]

GPIO 15: GPIO 15 is a strapping pin. Outputs PWM signal during boot. LOW at boot suppresses UART boot log messages.

 [dim]15 |[/dim]     pin led: PWM = GP25
 [dim]16 |[/dim]     pin button: PullUpInput = GP15
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:16[/yellow bold]

GPIO 15 is a JTAG pin. Using it disables JTAG debugging.

 [dim]15 |[/dim]     pin led: PWM = GP25
 [dim]16 |[/dim]     pin button: PullUpInput = GP15
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:17[/yellow bold]

GPIO 0: GPIO 0 is a strapping pin. LOW at boot = download mode. Ensure pull-up (internal or external) for normal boot.

 [dim]16 |[/dim]     pin button: PullUpInput = GP15
 [dim]17 |[/dim]     pin status: Output = GP0
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]
